d: Nine seconds of video. No words. Millions of views. New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani has turned a JD Vance victory graphic into a viral political takedown. After Vance claimed credit for economic and crime figures in New York, a Community Note challenged the numbers. Mamdani's response was pure internet politics. But this viral exchange also reveals a deeper political battle between the Trump administration and a mayor who has become one of MAGA's most prominent opponents. Gursshheen Gahllen brings you the details on Firstpost America.
